newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonian stocks stable, seen rangebound.
newsitem.headline: Estonian stocks stable, seen rangebound.

text.p: Trade on the Estonian bourse was quieter on Friday as prices generally stayed within the range set in recent days, dealers said.
They said the market was expected to remain stable next week.
The Talse increased by 0.28 percent to close on 259.87 with 47.8 million kroons of shares traded on the main list.
"Most stocks dropped in the morning but trade has been steady and prices have generally held," one trader said.
"Next week is expected to be the same as this week with no unexpected information to be released," another trader said.
"Most trade will occur between the positions used this week," he added.
Uhispank was the most traded stock on turnover of 12.7 million kroons, gaining 0.25 kroons to 56.25 kroons.
"Uhispank was up there again but it was mostly block trades," one trader said.
Hansapank turned over 18 million kroons of shares to end 0.20 kroons higher at 268.20 kroons after recording highs of 273.22 during the day.
On the over-the-counter market, total trade was 8.7 million kroons of shares with diversified industrialist Norma the most active stock.
Norma turned over 5.3 million kroons of shares to go 0.65 kroons higher to 75.55 kroons.
